103:     """Analytic selected first-order W1 branch, exact integer CDF segmentation."""
104:     @staticmethod
105:     def forward(ctx, a, b, ma, mb):
106:         aa, bb = a.detach().double().cpu().numpy(), b.detach().double().cpu().numpy()

119:     def backward(ctx, grad):

126: def _uniform_plan(ns, nr):
127:     """Exact positive quantile-overlap lengths, dependent only on both counts."""
128:     i = j = edge = 0
129:     ix, iy, lengths = [], [], []
130:     while i < ns and j < nr:
131:         right = min((i + 1) * nr, (j + 1) * ns)
132:         ix.append(i); iy.append(j); lengths.append(right - edge)
133:         edge = right
134:         if (i + 1) * nr == right:
135:             i += 1
136:         if (j + 1) * ns == right:
137:             j += 1
138:     assert edge == ns * nr and sum(lengths) == ns * nr
139:     return tuple(ix), tuple(iy), tuple(z / (ns * nr) for z in lengths)

145:         raise ValueError('Same CPU/CUDA device and float32/float64 features required')

148:     if len(ma) != len(a) or len(mb) != len(b) or feature_chunk < 1:
149:         raise ValueError('Mass/feature length or feature_chunk mismatch')
150:     if not bool(torch.isfinite(a).all() and torch.isfinite(b).all()):
151:         raise ValueError('Finite feature values required')
152:     uniform = len(set(ma.ticks)) == 1 and len(set(mb.ticks)) == 1 and ma.ticks[0] > 0 and mb.ticks[0] > 0
153:     if use_uniform_fastpath and uniform:
154:         ix, iy, lengths = _uniform_plan(len(a), len(b))
155:         ix = torch.tensor(ix, device=a.device, dtype=torch.int64)
156:         iy = torch.tensor(iy, device=a.device, dtype=torch.int64)
157:         lengths = torch.tensor(lengths, device=a.device, dtype=torch.float64)
158:         result = []

108: ## Five distribution terms and full empirical reference
109: 
110: Only D={full_window, PSD, noise, coordinate_RMS, temporal_joint} enters the
111: gradient comparison. All original outer weights are one. Four other original
112: terms C={source_order, source_valley, REAL_identity, box_correction} are excluded
113: from both arms and the full reference; no total-training conflict claim is made.
114: 
115: Within each region, both domains have their own unit-total empirical laws. Full
116: F includes every SOURCE and REAL parent once, with unequal regional counts.
117: No truncation, duplicating to equal counts, quantile grid or entropic approximation
118: is permitted. Scalar W1 is the exact finite weighted quantile integral with
119: integer CDF mass partitions; distances and reductions remain floating point.
120: The full reference keeps the original parent order. Sampled laws keep fixed
121: region/microbatch/slot order. Stable sorting chooses the tie branch;
122: abs(0) has gradient zero, and a zero coordinate-W1 RMS has gradient zero.
123: Tied distinct parents are never merged. Selected tie gradients are not unique
124: classical gradients. Equal-mass fast paths must agree with the generic integer
125: CDF implementation on artificial values and selected gradients before use.
126: 
127: * full_window: each of four families averages coordinate-W1 mean and 64-direction
128:   sliced-W1 mean, then sums regions with original SOURCE mass, then averages the
129:   four families.
130: * coordinate_RMS: per family and region take sqrt(mean_j W_j^2), sum regions with
131:   SOURCE mass, then average the four families. Do not interchange these reductions.
132: * temporal_joint: half the sum of the 31-coordinate marginal mean and 64-direction
133:   sliced mean, weighted by original SOURCE regional mass.
134: * PSD: 0.5*(global W1 + mean of seven Q1-Q7 conditional W1)/0.01. Global SOURCE and
135:   REAL masses are separate; the conditional part averages seven regions equally.
136: * noise: global W1 of baseline RMS and lag-1 ACF, each divided by its original
137:   frozen noise scale, then averaged. Each domain uses its own global masses.
138: 
139: At full F, every global SOURCE parent has mass 1/6593 and every global REAL
140: parent 1/21047. For a stratified sampled law, a SOURCE occurrence in region r
141: has mass mS_r/K_r and a REAL occurrence has mass mR_r/K_r. Both domains must not
142: be assigned the same regional masses. CUDA computes the original canonical,
143: features, standardization, casts and projected features; host integer-CDF W1
144: can supply values/selected derivatives without replacing the original chain.
